description: CodeScope-local specification for supplying Eliware Test v8 records to reviews.

authoritativeFor: CodeScope Test-spec evidence selection and review-input boundaries.
notAuthoritativeFor: Repository requirements, Eliware Test specification wording, exemptions, operational procedures, publication, deployment, or project behavior.

testSpecifications.applicability: For ordinary reviewed repositories, read only the records named by package.json eliware.apply from the adjacent test/specs/conventions directory; profile names are safe single-segment lowercase identifiers and map directly to <profile>.json. For @eliware/test, do not load or inject separate records because its own specs are supplied in normal repository context.
testSpecifications.authority: Eliware Test is the sole authority for shared repository requirements and specification text.
testSpecifications.missingEvidence: If the adjacent eliware/test checkout or a selected profile record is unavailable, report Test-spec alignment as unverified. Do not infer or import requirements.
testSpecifications.scope: Supply selected Test specification records as review evidence. Do not redefine, duplicate, or extend their requirements.
